CREATE TABLE `artist_designs` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `image` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `is_visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,

  `min_sessions` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `max_sessions` int(11) NOT NULL,

bookings.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `bookings` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `artist_user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tattoo_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `booking_type` enum('custom','flash') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flash',
  `custom_tattoo_details` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`custom_tattoo_details`)),
  `booking_date` date NOT NULL,
  `start_time_utc` time NOT NULL,
  `end_time_utc` time NOT NULL,
  `timezone` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',
  `has_consultation` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `consultation_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `consultation_start_time_utc` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `consultation_end_time_utc` time DEFAULT NULL,
  `consultation_completed` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `consultation_timing_type` enum('combined','separate') DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stores the artist''s consultation timing preference at time of booking',
  `consultation_booking_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','confirmed','cancelled','completed','no_show','rescheduled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `cancelled_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_initiated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_type` enum('client','artist','system') DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_deadline` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancellation_window_hours` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rescheduled_from_booking_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `rescheduled_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `rescheduled_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `reschedule_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `reschedule_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `reschedule_limit` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reschedule_status` enum('pending','accepted','declined','completed') DEFAULT NULL,
  `reschedule_requested_by` enum('client','artist') DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_intent_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_provider` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'stripe',
  `viva_order_code` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `viva_transaction_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_status` enum('pending','paid','refunded','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `deposit_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `full_amount_paid` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `platform_fee` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `tax_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `tax_rate` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tax_country` varchar(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tax_label` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_amount_paid` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `currency` varchar(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  `deposit_released` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `deposit_released_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `remaining_amount_released` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `remaining_amount_released_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_code` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_code_entered_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `refund_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `deposit_forfeited` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `refund_intent_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `refunded_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `refund_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `refund_status` enum('pending','processing','completed','failed','partial') DEFAULT NULL,
  `platform_fee_refunded` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `completed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `no_show_marked_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `questions_answers` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`questions_answers`)),
  `action_history` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`action_history`)),
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `reminder_sent_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_calendar_event_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_meet_link` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pay_artist` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `bookings_completion_code_unique` (`completion_code`),
  KEY `bookings_rescheduled_by_foreign` (`rescheduled_by`),
  KEY `bookings_user_id_index` (`user_id`),
  KEY `bookings_artist_user_id_index` (`artist_user_id`),
  KEY `bookings_tattoo_id_index` (`tattoo_id`),
  KEY `bookings_booking_date_index` (`booking_date`),
  KEY `bookings_status_index` (`status`),
  KEY `bookings_cancelled_by_index` (`cancelled_by`),
  KEY `bookings_rescheduled_from_booking_id_index` (`rescheduled_from_booking_id`),
  KEY `bookings_booking_type_index` (`booking_type`),
  KEY `bookings_deposit_released_index` (`deposit_released`),
  KEY `bookings_remaining_amount_released_index` (`remaining_amount_released`),
  KEY `bookings_completion_code_index` (`completion_code`),
  KEY `bookings_cancellation_deadline_index` (`cancellation_deadline`),
  KEY `bookings_consultation_date_index` (`consultation_date`),
  KEY `bookings_google_calendar_event_id_index` (`google_calendar_event_id`),
  KEY `bookings_consultation_booking_id_index` (`consultation_booking_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_artist_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`artist_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_cancelled_by_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`cancelled_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_consultation_booking_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`consultation_booking_id`) REFERENCES `bookings` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_rescheduled_by_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`rescheduled_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_rescheduled_from_booking_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`rescheduled_from_booking_id`) REFERENCES `bookings` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_tattoo_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`tattoo_id`) REFERENCES `artist_designs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_user_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=10 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
